Class ResourceSimulationCoupler

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.resource.ResourceSimulationCoupler
public final class ResourceSimulationCoupler extends Object

Resource Simulation Coupler

Couples planetary macroeconomic, thermodynamic, and ecological tensors to topological discrete H3 hexagonal cells for live cliodynamic simulations:

  • Lotka-Volterra & Farquhar Ecological Scaling: Distributes continental plant biomass, soil organic carbon, faunal livestock density, and pelagic marine phytoplankton based on cell biomes.
  • Geophysical Lithospheric Tensors: Samples 10 sub-crustal deposits (coal, petroleum, natural gas, uranium, iron, copper, precious metals, rare earth elements, geothermal flux, accessible aquifers, and clay).
  • Discrete Polychrome & Multi-Channel Raster Ingestion: Maps imported cartographic rasters to cell attributes.
